id: AUTH-COOKIE: delayed guest session response must preserve a newer login cookie
message:
A guest GET sent before login returns Set-Cookie nrh_auth=""; Max-Age=0 after the successful login response.

true !== false

id: AUTH-COOKIE-IDENTITY: delayed valid read must not restore the previous account cookie
message:
A valid GET for account A still rewrites its old authenticated cookie after a newer login to account B.

true !== false

id: CART-BOOTSTRAP: concurrent cookie-less read must not replace a cart containing the new item
message:
Two initial requests create different Cart-Tokens; the late empty read overwrites the cookie of the cart containing the added product.

false !== true

id: BANNERS-SAVE: competing saves must accept exactly one revision
evidence: Exclusive file creation and revision check preserve the winning save; test data is isolated.
